title: api_check.v1
description: One `llens db api-check` result: the Neon Data API's access rules (export-db@25/@26), probed. Status codes, PostgREST error codes and row counts only: never a URL, the email, a token or a response body. `ok` is true only when every probe got what it expects.

signed_in.description: the operator's Neon Auth sign-in gave a JWT

name.description: operator_api: the operator's token reads an api view (2xx AND rows > 0, since the gate answers a wrong subject with an empty 2xx); anonymous_api: an anonymous token is refused (403); no_token_api: no token is refused (401); operator_li / operator_withheld / operator_public_rpc: schema li, a withheld table and a public RPC are unreachable (404 or 406)

status.description: the HTTP status; null when the probe was skipped

code.description: the error body's PostgREST code or SQLSTATE, on a 4xx/5xx
